Pressing the mic doesn\'t pause the music

When voice typing or an assistant takes over the sound, the music is started again right away, so it stops for only about half a second. The phone\'s microphone may pick up the music from the speaker.
Off: the music stays paused while the microphone is in use and starts again when it is done.
Needs “Videos don\'t pause the music” above to be on. Until then the music starts again after the microphone is done.

Drag to set an app\'s own volume; 🔊 / 🔇 mutes it. Apps playing now (▶) are listed first. 100% = left alone.
Finish the setup on the main screen first.
Choosing an output for each app and setting each app\'s volume are Pro features. A one-time purchase unlocks them (purchase will be available in a later version).
Tick your music apps. Their sound stays on Bluetooth; every other app plays on the phone speaker. One music app must stay ticked.
At least one music app must stay selected.
Should a video pause your music?

By default Android pauses the music when another app starts a video. SplitAudio can switch on Android\'s built-in multi audio focus, so both apps keep playing. It is a system setting (it survives a reboot); calls and alarms still pause everything. The music stops for about a second at the moment it is switched on.
Turn it on (both apps play at the same time)
